idea-plugin.name: Upload SSH File
idea-plugin.description:
Upload files/directories to remote servers via SSH SFTP.
  • Right-click file/directory → Upload SSH File
  • Supports multi-file and batch upload (reusable batch task sets, sequential sub-tasks)
  • MD5 checksum verification (Linux) / file-size verification (Windows)
  • Post-upload SSH command execution with blacklist, keyword and optional AI safety layers
  • Server and path configuration management, import/export of the full configuration
  • 8 UI languages (en/中文/de/fr/es/ja/ko/ar)
  • 1.0.8: Task IDs + copyable build snippets (Gradle Groovy/Kotlin, Maven, Ant) and a standalone CLI — bundled inside the plugin archive — that re-runs a saved upload task from a build hook or a terminal, with cross-process per-server upload locking shared by GUI and CLI
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.8
  • Standalone CLI entry, shipped inside the plugin archive (never distributed separately): the launcher uploadsshfile-cli.bat is a static packaged file — usable immediately after install/upgrade/hot-reload, and self-healed if deleted or edited. It uploads the saved file list and runs the remote command group of a task by its Task ID, e.g. from a build hook or a terminal.
  • Task ID system: every upload task (single and batch) has one editable business ID — new tasks pre-fill a pure-digit snowflake ID, new IDs must be alphanumeric, legacy UUID IDs keep working unchanged.
  • The Copy button generates ready-to-paste build snippets for Gradle Groovy / Gradle Kotlin / Maven / Ant. Snippets carry only the Task ID: single task uploads = the file list saved when the Upload dialog last closed (multi-select supported; change files without re-copying the snippet), batch task uploads = the sub-task lists saved in the task. Gradle snippets (single and batch alike) guard against uploading after a failed build, and never flip the build result on upload failure; explanatory comments inside snippets follow your IDE display language (8 languages). Maven/Ant variants are marked "not verified against a real build".
  • Compatibility note: the earlier --file command-line flag was removed — snippets pasted from a 1.0.8 pre-release build must be re-copied once.
  • Target confirmation before execution: CLI and GUI batch runs list every "host → remote path (file count)" and require y/N; --yes (present in pasted snippets) skips it as an explicit automation opt-in.
  • Cross-process per-server upload lock shared by GUI and CLI (stale locks are released by the OS).
  • Progressive timeout behaviour wired up end-to-end: long-running remote commands now ask "keep waiting?" at 30s / 1min / 2min / every 5min instead of silently stopping at 3 minutes; answering "continue" waits without an overall limit (see manual for details).
  • Optional per-path "auto-create remote directory"; staged mkdir failures are reported instead of being swallowed.
  • Config export/import upgraded to v3.2 including the single-task snapshot, so a fresh machine can use the CLI right after import (local values always win when already set).
  • All eight language bundles brought to full key parity (enforced by tests), fixing bare key names and garbled translations in non-English IDEs.
  • After installing or upgrading the plugin, fully restart IDEA (File → Exit) once.
1.0.7
  • Stopped bundling the IDE-private package com.intellij.ant (vendored java-compiler-ant-tasks jar removed from the distribution) — clears the JetBrains Marketplace compatibility warning
1.0.6
  • Fix Marketplace verification failure ("archive cannot be extracted") by shipping the standard buildPlugin archive; the 7z store-mode zip is now packaged separately (-store) for offline distribution only
1.0.5
  • Add Language submenu in right-click menu with checkmark for current language
  • Auto-detect IDE language on first launch, fallback to English if unsupported
1.0.4
  • Fix batch upload progress bar precision and sub-task reset issue
  • Fix marketplace verification API deprecation warnings
  • Auto-clean intermediate build artifacts after packaging
1.0.3
  • Fix batch upload progress calculation
  • Fix i18n missing keys
  • Update deprecated API usages
  • Fix plugin configuration defect
